messages.subject: readModels skipped R-SQUARE?
parts:
Hi developers,

Thank you for this nice package which saves me quite a lot of keyboard typing.

I just find out that the R-SQUARE section of mplus output is totally omited in the readModels()$parameters slot. I need to use the data from "Residual Variance" column, are there any way to accomplish this?

TIA.

messages.author: 065110cca96a6373
messages.subject: Re: [MplusAutomation] readModels skipped R-SQUARE?
parts:
Hi Huashan,

If you have the stdyx output, 1 - standardized residual variance should equal the r square.

I know adding extraction of that section has been discussed before, but I am not sure anyone is actively working on it.

Cheers,

Josh

Hi all,

FYI, I just implemented one of the more popular feature requests: R-SQUARE output extraction. I've tested it on several output files and it seems to work properly. Hope this proves useful to others. You can obtain this feature by installing the development version of the package from Github: https://github.com/michaelhallquist/MplusAutomation.

Best,
Michael
